svg.title: Sealed benchmark results
svg.desc: Sealed offline benchmark, fictional 130-note vault, 72 questions. Complete evidence on the 64 answerable questions: grep 37, FTS 33, synaptic 46, synaptic compact 37. Two-hop bridge questions (20): 0, 0, 10 and 10. Mean packet size in estimated tokens: 388, 333, 527 and 334.
